test_end_to_end: test the RunAlphafoldTest end to end prediction pipeline with mocked data pipeline and model runner
run_predict_structure: run the predict_structure function with a FASTA file and mocked model runners to generate PDB outputs
test_models_to_relax_all: test the ModelsToRelax ALL mode to verify relaxed PDB and CIF files are generated with relax metrics
test_models_to_relax_none: test the ModelsToRelax NONE mode to verify only unrelaxed PDB and CIF output files are produced
verify_plddt_bfactor: verify that the pLDDT confidence score is correctly written to the B-factor column of the PDB file
